product: MM-ART-011 permanent Harz and Rhenish topographic wall reliefs

scope.intended_use: Two unique 600 x 400 mm indoor decorative terrain artworks, each produced as two four-color main prints and permanently assembled without adhesive, rear grid, magnets, or replaceable sections.
scope.user_context: Adult indoor customer; optional customer-supplied low-power rear halo/front-through lighting; production on the Anycubic Kobra 3 Max Combo.
out_of_scope: Wall anchors, electrical equipment, outdoor use, survey/navigation/planning/mine-safety claims, repeated disassembly, and universal load rating

entities.name: Three concealed one-way loose connector springs
Local snap-in hanger and standoff set

assembly.direction: Connector inserted into the first seam-edge pocket, then the halves are pressed together in panel X.
assembly.contact_mode: Three loose one-way spring/tenon connectors plus discrete seam locating lands.
assembly.sequence_notes: One assembly cycle; removal is not a service requirement and may be destructive.

evidence.uncertainty_note: Topology and lifecycle intent are approved; exact connector dimensions, clearance, retention and warp response require CAD and a process-matched coupon.

failure_modes.mode: Connector is too tight, too loose, fractures, or permits a terrain seam step
failure_modes.effect: Assembly failure, damaged one-off panel, visible height discontinuity, or separation during handling
failure_modes.mitigation: Parametric multi-clearance coupon, in-plane spring orientation, three distributed connectors, locked seam samples, and assembled handling/proof test

acceptance_criteria: At least one coupon variant assembles once without crack or whitening, holds the two seam strips flush, and resists the defined pull/step checks.

interfaces.name: Frozen 16-bit global terrain field controls both seam-locked halves
keepouts_and_access: color bands do not replace height data

evidence.uncertainty_note: Source routes are selected, but exact frozen acquisitions, hashes, masters and transforms do not yet exist.

failure_modes.mode: Halves use different normalization, sampling, source state, or seam simplification
failure_modes.effect: Visible terrain discontinuity, distortion, or unrebuildable product
failure_modes.mitigation: Immutable global 16-bit master, one transform per pilot, seam-locked samples, hashes and comparison gates

acceptance_criteria: Both halves share one hash-bound master/transform and pass physical-aspect, seam-height and reference/manufacturing comparison limits.

interfaces.name: Local hanger and standoffs support each terrain artwork at the wall

loads_and_performance.load: assembled artwork self-weight; exact mass and proof factor unknown until CAD/slicer evidence
loads_and_performance.load_path: each main half receives its own upper support so the center seam is not the primary gravity path

evidence.uncertainty_note: Wall substrate, anchors, exact part mass, connector geometry and physical proof result are unknown.

failure_modes.mode: Hanger, snap socket, anchor, or substrate fails
failure_modes.effect: Artwork falls and may cause injury or property damage
failure_modes.mitigation: Exclude universal anchors, provide independent support per half, qualify the printed interface, and require substrate-appropriate installation

acceptance_criteria: The complete printed hanger/standoff system survives the documented mass-based proof load without crack, disengagement, or permanent set; wall-anchor selection remains installer controlled.

interfaces.name: Optional customer LED system remains inside open rear keep-outs

evidence.uncertainty_note: The customer LED product, power, temperature, adhesive and wiring remain unknown and outside the product claim.

failure_modes.mode: Oversized or hot lighting conflicts with printed parts or overheats the open cavity
failure_modes.effect: Poor lighting, softened plastic, wiring damage, or fire risk from customer equipment
failure_modes.mitigation: Mechanical preparation only, open ventilation, declared generic envelope, and no electrical compatibility or safety claim

acceptance_criteria: A passive envelope gauge passes through all declared routes and the unlit artwork remains fully functional.

interfaces.owner: Customer for electrical system; MM-ART-011 for passive keep-outs

drivers: Fit-sensitive concealed one-way seam and snap-in mount interfaces
Coupling of immutable terrain data, dense mesh, color bands, center seam and lighting cutters
Four-color large-format manufacturing plus relief, fit, proof-load and appearance verification

blocking_unknowns: Exact connector and snap clearances for the selected filament/profile
Exact frozen DEM acquisitions, hashes and pilot transforms
Exact filament products, batches, conditioning and Anycubic profiles
As-built mass, wall-anchor/substrate selection and physical proof-load result

criticality.rationale: The reliefs are decorative, but failed printed wall interfaces or unsuitable customer lighting have credible injury, property-damage, or heat consequences and therefore require controlled tests.
credible_failure_effects: Damaged one-off assembly or sharp terrain fragments
Misleading terrain if provenance/exaggeration is omitted

decision.rationale: Proceed through concept approval, then coupon-first interface CAD and immutable global relief pipelines. Production/release remains blocked until exact data/profile, connector fit, assembled load behavior and human appearance review are evidenced.

warnings.message: The one-way connector and snap-in mounting interfaces have no exact process-qualified clearance or physical result.
Concealed seam pockets must remain printable in the face-up terrain orientation and must not create unsupported roofs or terrain read-through.
Test methods are selected, but numeric pull, step, insertion-force and proof-load thresholds must be fixed after mass and coupon geometry exist.

next_actions.action: Approve a replacement concept showing two permanent halves, concealed one-way connectors, local snap-in standoffs and no rear grid.
next_actions.exit_criterion: Human concept approval references revision 0.3.0 and the stored concept artifact.

next_actions.action: Generate a multi-clearance seam/connector coupon before full terrain CAD.
next_actions.exit_criterion: At least one process-matched coupon variant meets assembly, crack/whitening, flushness and pull/step acceptance.

next_actions.action: Freeze each DEM source/master and qualify the local hanger/standoff sockets and complete artwork proof load.
next_actions.exit_criterion: Hash-bound terrain gates and recorded physical mounting tests pass in the exact production scope.
